const S = 0.1::String
const F = 7::Float
const I = (-2.5)::Int

schema VS scope explicit:
    s: String

schema VF scope explicit:
    f: Float

schema VI scope explicit:
    i: Int

initial:
    VS s: S
    VF f: F
    VI i: I

rule rstr:
    VS v where v.s == 0.1::String
->
    log info "s"

rule rflt:
    VF v where v.f == 7::Float
->
    log info "f"

rule rint:
    VI v where v.i == (-2.5)::Int
->
